protocol.benchmark: typed-decisions test split: 400 JSON states from four workflows, five typed questions each (2,000 questions: 600 choice, 600 noul, 800 score)
protocol.client: one request (one state, its five questions) at a time over HTTP to /v1/systemone, timed by the client
protocol.accuracy: argmax of the returned probabilities against the gold label, over all 2,000 questions; a rejected request counts as wrong on its five questions; 95 % bootstrap interval over states
protocol.ece: ten-bin expected calibration error of the top probability, pooled over the answered questions
